dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Visible gradual narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior region in a symmetrical pattern.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with a minor asymmetrical convex deviation on the right-hand side of the mid-body.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median pixel intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey patches visible across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse transitions between pigmented and depigmented regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Faint, light-toned linear markings oriented longitudinally on the dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A dark, thin longitudinal line marking the central dorsal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of faint linear scars consistent with superficial epidermal abrasions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct dark coloration of the central dorsal ridge.
